extracted.intended_audience: museum program evaluators, IMLS staff, museum grantees, policy analysts
extracted.subtask_description: Outcome and organizational metrics used in the IMLS Museums for America evaluation to assess project effects (partnerships, organizational development, programming, audience, community, post-grant persistence), with stratification by primary activity area, museum size, award amount, and project duration.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one positive partnership effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicator whether the project produced at least one positive partnership-related outcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as counts and percents (Yes/No/Total) across strata (primary activity area, museum size, award amount). Used to summarize overall partnership-related benefits of grants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improved skills in building partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent-reported improvement in skills related to building partnerships as a result of the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary Yes/No with counts and percents; appears in tables by primary activity area and other stratifiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthened ongoing partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported strengthening of pre-existing/ongoing partnerships tied to the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marked in tables (Yes/No) and flagged when statistically significant (* p≤.05).

rubrics_metrics.name: Developed new/ongoing partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Project resulted in development of new partnerships or continuation/renewal of partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captured as Yes/No; used alongside other partnership metrics to characterize partnership formation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked with educational institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Project engaged/partnered with educational institutions (as reported).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as part of partnership-type breakdown (Yes/No counts and percents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked with youth organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Project engaged/partnered with youth organizations (as reported).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included in partnership-type counts and percents by activity area and other stratifiers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked with other museums
rubrics_metrics.description: Project involved collaboration with other museums.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary reporting (Yes/No) shown in tables by primary activity area and size/award strata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Worked with community organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Project engaged community organizations as partners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appears in partnership-type breakdowns; often flagged for statistical significance when relevant (* p≤.05).

rubrics_metrics.name: Developed new types of partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Project led to development of new types of partnerships not previously used by the institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported Yes/No; helps capture novelty/diversification of partnership relationships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decreased ability to attract partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent-reported decrease in the institution's ability to attract partners after the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unfavorable outcome tracked as part of partnership effects; counts and percents reported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increased ability to attract more partners
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported increase in the institution's ability to attract additional partners following the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positive partnership-capacity outcome recorded as Yes/No and shown across stratifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: No effect on partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent indicates the project had no effect on partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the complement to positive/negative partnership effects; reported in tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one positive organizational development effect
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicator whether the project produced at least one positive organizational development outcome.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported Yes/No with counts/percents by primary activity area, museum size, and award amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in program development
rubrics_metrics.description: Project enhanced staff capacity specifically in program development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary Yes/No measure; flagged when statistically significant (* p≤.05). Reported across strata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in creating new kinds of exhibitions
rubrics_metrics.description: Project increased staff skills/capacity to create new kinds of exhibitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captured as Yes/No with counts/percents; significance indicated where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in reaching new/larger audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Project improved staff ability to reach new or larger audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yes/No metric used to evaluate audience-reaching capacity improvements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in forming external partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Project increased staff capacity to form external partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as a binary outcome (Yes/No) and compared across activity areas and sizes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in working across departments
rubrics_metrics.description: Project improved staff capacity to collaborate across departmental boundaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yes/No reporting; often annotated with statistical significance when differences are meaningful (* p≤.05).

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhanced staff capacity in using outcomes based evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Staff capacity to use outcomes-based evaluation was improved by the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tracked as a Yes/No outcome; part of organizational development measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improved staff cohesion and commitment to mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Project led to improved staff cohesion and stronger commitment to the institution's mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as Yes/No; used in organizational impact assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Greater alignment of staff responsibilities with mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Project produced greater alignment between staff roles/responsibilities and institutional mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary outcome (Yes/No) reported by museum size/award amount strata.

rubrics_metrics.name: Greater board involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Project increased board involvement in the institution's work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as Yes/No and annotated when statistically significant (* p≤.05).

rubrics_metrics.name: Helped institution fulfill its mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent reports the project helped the institution fulfill its mission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captured Yes/No; shown across museum size/award amount tables (sometimes with significance markers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Increased ability to attract outside funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Project increased the institution's ability to attract outside funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yes/No metric; reported with counts/percents and used to assess financial leverage effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decreased ability to attract outside funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Project decreased the institution's ability to attract outside funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unfavorable outcome tracked alongside increases and 'no effect' responses.

rubrics_metrics.name: No effect on the institution / not applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent indicates the project had no effect on the institution or the question was not applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a baseline/complement category in organizational effect tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one post-grant effect (programming/exhibits)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicator whether programming/exhibits produced by the project continued to have effects post-grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables show counts/percents for 'At Least One Post-Grant Effect' vs 'No Post-Grant Effects' by primary activity area and for projects completed three or more years.

rubrics_metrics.name: No post-grant effects (programming/exhibits)
rubrics_metrics.description: No sustained post-grant effects observed for programming/exhibits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as complement to post-grant positive effects; shown by primary activity area.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one post-grant organizational development effect
rubrics_metrics.description: One or more organizational development outcomes persisted after the grant period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yes/No counts and percents reported for projects completed three or more years and stratified by activity area and partnership status.

rubrics_metrics.name: No post-grant organizational effects
rubrics_metrics.description: No organizational development outcomes persisted post-grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as complement in post-grant tables; reported by activity area and partnership status.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one post-grant audience effect
rubrics_metrics.description: One or more audience-related outcomes (e.g., reaching new/larger audiences) persisted after the grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported Yes/No with counts/percents in post-grant tables by activity area and partnership status.

rubrics_metrics.name: No post-grant audience effects
rubrics_metrics.description: No audience-related outcomes persisted post-grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complement category in post-grant audience tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one post-grant community effect
rubrics_metrics.description: One or more community-related outcomes persisted following the grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Captured as Yes/No in post-grant community-effect tables, stratified by primary activity area and partnership status.

rubrics_metrics.name: No post-grant community effects
rubrics_metrics.description: No community-related outcomes persisted post-grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complement to positive post-grant community effects in tables.

rubrics_metrics.name: At least one post-grant partnerships effect
rubrics_metrics.description: One or more partnership-related outcomes persisted after the grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as Yes/No with counts/percents by primary activity area and by whether the project originally entailed partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: No post-grant partnerships effects
rubrics_metrics.description: No partnership-related outcomes persisted following the grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as complement in post-grant partnership tables; counts and percents provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of different post-grant effects (1, 2, 3+)
rubrics_metrics.description: Count of distinct types of post-grant effects observed for a project, categorized as 1, 2, or 3+ different post-grant effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables show counts and percent within each 'number of different post-grant effects' category; cross-tabulated with whether the project entailed partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project entailed partnerships (Yes/No)
rubrics_metrics.description: Binary indicator whether the project originally entailed partnerships; used to stratify outcomes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a stratifier in multiple tables (post-grant effects, organizational/audience/community/partnership outcomes) to compare outcomes for projects that did vs did not entail partnerships.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project duration: Completed for three or more years
rubrics_metrics.description: Identification of projects that were completed for three or more years (used to assess persistence of post-grant effects).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Post-grant effect tables restrict to projects completed three or more years; counts/percents reported to examine long-term outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary activity area
rubrics_metrics.description: Categorization of projects by primary activity area: Digitization/Collection, Technology/Online Resources, Organizational Development, Programming/Exhibits, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All effect metrics are cross-tabulated by primary activity area to compare outcomes across activity types.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stratification by museum size
rubrics_metrics.description: Grouping of projects by museum size (Small, Medium, Large) for comparison of effects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organizational development and other outcomes are reported by museum size (counts/percents) to detect size-related differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stratification by award amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Grouping of projects by award amount (<$50,000; $50,000–99,000; $100,000 or more).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to compare outcomes by grant size; tables show counts and percents for each award amount category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical significance indicator
rubrics_metrics.description: Asterisk notation indicating statistical significance: '* Statistically significant p≤.05'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used throughout tables to flag differences across strata that meet p≤.05 significance; guides interpretation of whether observed differences are likely to be meaningful.
